The '''Royal Museum of Alderaan''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that belonged to [[House Alde]] and served as the custodians of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] history. It was overseen by a person that held the title of [[Noble Curator]] and contained a range of priceless artifacts and relics.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Corwin]] used fake relics in the Royal Museum to transport messages to [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]]. This led to [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Zacar Girard]] tasking an [[Hunter (individual)|unidentified]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] with the retrieval of the messages. The Curator [[Peema Ahuff]] also sought the return of the preserved head of [[Darth Bandon]], the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] of [[Darth Malak]], who had been killed by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].
